reads.region: Brunello di Montalcino and Chianti Classico
reads.sell: Tuscan Sangiovese, from Chianti Classico or Brunello di Montalcino, with sour cherry, tomato leaf, dried herbs and a little leather on bright acidity and dusty tannin. It sings with tomato sauces, roast meats and aged pecorino.

why.grape: Sour cherry and tomato leaf riding high acidity and dusty, firm tannin are the tells of Sangiovese.
why.climate: Tart red fruit, high acidity and alcohol no higher than medium plus say a moderate climate, its hills cooled by elevation.
